proof_groups.grouping_reason: The entry witness decomposes exactly the four structural cases consumed by the four return witnesses, while the two derivation witnesses use the same dispatch definition and DLL-member-not-sentinel fact. Keeping them together permits one worker to reuse a single suffixed DLL split/join/distinctness helper family and remains within the seven-of-twelve bound.
proof_groups.proof_strategy: First establish suffixed spatial helper lemmas for separated node-link distinctness, splitting a dllseg at a designated list member, reassembling a dllseg after inserting one node, and deriving that a DLL member differs from its sentinel. Prove the entry witness by opening xizi_dll, splitting on anchor membership versus sentinel equality, taking a first-occurrence list split in the member case, and destructing the suffix for the four generated assertion alternatives. For every return witness choose the full-list side of the generated disjunction and fold the updated fields into xizi_dll using the dispatch equality already present in the precondition. Finish the two contract-derivation witnesses by choosing the original head/nodes and discharging an identity wand after reducing dispatch; the member case uses the member-not-sentinel helper.
